title: PawlyClinic: Digital Veterinary Care Platform
description:
PawlyClinic is a digital veterinary care platform that connects pet owners with licensed veterinarians through online consultations, appointment booking, and in-clinic referrals. It provides a convenient way for users to access veterinary advice, manage pet health records, and receive treatment without always needing to visit a clinic physically.
